page_title: PAU 1-1 RBL | St. Pauli v RB Leipzig 27/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Florian Exner has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The substitution is prepared. Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yan Diomande.
90+3' 1 - 1 Goal! Peter Gulacsi gets a hand on the penalty from Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
90+3' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+2' David Raum (RB Leipzig) trips an opposition player and Florian Exner signals a foul. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for St. Pauli.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Peter Gulacsi pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
88' Substitution. Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli) replaces Manolis Saliakas.
88' David Raum (RB Leipzig) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

87' A snap shot by Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Nikola Vasilj produces a good save to thwart him. The referee signals a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
85' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Christoph Baumgartner will be replaced by Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antonio Nusa trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig).
81' Florian Exner blows his whistle. David Raum (RB Leipzig) commits a foul after dangerous play.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.

79' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for St. Pauli.
78' Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli) is adjudged offside.
76' Substitution. Joel Fujita leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mathias Rasmussen (St. Pauli).
76' Alexander Blessin has decided to substitute James Sands and he is replaced by Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli).
76' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Danel Sinani.
76' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
74' David Raum (RB Leipzig) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
72' The attendance for today's match is 29147.
71' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
71' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
70' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from RB Leipzig.
67' Here is a change. Ricky-Jade Jones is going off and Alexander Blessin gives the last tactical orders to Martijn Kaars (St. Pauli).
66' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Nikola Vasilj. He makes it 0:1.
66' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but it's cleared.
65' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
64' Substitution. Romulo Cardoso makes way for Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig).
64' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
63' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
61' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:9.
59' The linesman raises his flag. Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) is adjudged offside.
57' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
56' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
55' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) attempts to put the ball in from a rebound with his long-range shot, but it isn't accurate enough, and the ball goes high over the crossbar.
53' The corner from Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) is intercepted by the defence.
53' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and St. Pauli will have a corner.
51' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by David Raum (RB Leipzig) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
49' Today's referee Florian Exner rightly decides to book Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) for his harsh tackle.
47' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

47' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.
46' Florian Exner blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) brought his opponent down.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
45+1' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

44' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Nikola Vasilj pulls off a comfortable save.
43' James Sands (St. Pauli) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florian Exner blows his whistle for a foul.
42' Flag goes up against Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
40' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
37' David Raum (RB Leipzig) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
36' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
35' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
32' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) makes a rough challenge and Florian Exner blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
29' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
28' The RB Leipzig players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
25' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
23' David Raum (RB Leipzig) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
21' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
19' St. Pauli take a short corner kick.
18' Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender. St. Pauli have been awarded a corner kick.
16' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
14' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
13' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to RB Leipzig.
13' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
11' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
10' The ball is cleared after Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
9' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ricky-Jade Jones (St. Pauli) heads on.
8' What a great touch by Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig)! He picks up a precise pass and produces a long-range shot, but his fabulous effort smashes off the right post!
7' A pass from Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) is intercepted by Peter Gulacsi and the move breaks down.
6' Florian Exner interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig).
3' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Florian Exner.
